fusions.name: Billowing Sheet
fusions.desc: Snaps a sheet out on a wingbeat in a 4-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps a wet cloth at a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 7 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach, with a 40% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Eiderdown Nest
fusions.desc: Lays a nest of cloth and down where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Quilted Lining
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 6%, and you take 12% less frost damage.
